review_description: The inverter is housed in a plastic box that looks kind of cheap and it does have a fan that operates.I have wondered how reliable this would be but it never seems to get too hot.

Only 2 of 3 SolarQuotes suppliers quoted. Got a 3.51 kW system  installed in < 4 weeks from order by Solar Winds. Professional installers even checked existing PV system (NuEnergy) DC breaker and found in wired reverse polarity and fixed. I have recommended Solar Winds to family and friends.
There were a number of suppliers around the same price and quality of equipment mostly  interstate. I choose a local supplier .

As we live in the rural area we appreciated the fact that 'Solar Winds @ Kadina' organise everything that is required so we didn't have to orchestrate Etsa, Electrician etc to coincide with the installation which is very hard to do when you live in the country.
